```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggpubr)
```

# load data
```{r}
RNA_based_fungal_trait_relabund <- read.csv("../../Analysis/Microbial Communities/Imputed Biomass/Results/RNA_based_fungal_trait_relabund_mip.csv")
RNA_fungal_trait_biomass <- read.csv("../../Analysis/Microbial Communities/Imputed Biomass/Results/RNA_based_fungal_trait_biomass_mip.csv")
```

# make depth discrete so boxplot will work
```{r}
discrete.depth = mutate(RNA_based_fungal_trait_relabund, core_bottom_depth_cm = as.character(core_bottom_depth_cm)) # make a dataframe in which depth is a discrete variable
discrete.depth$core_bottom_depth_cm <- factor(discrete.depth$core_bottom_depth_cm, levels=c("7.5", "15", "22.5", "30", "37.5", "45")) # put the levels of depth in order
```

# define common characteristics for both plot panels
```{r}
fontSizeControl = theme(text = element_text(size = 7)) # code to add to each ggplot to set font size

makeMargins = theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 5.5, b = 20, l = 20)) # widen left margin of each plot so the panel labels can fit in top left. 5.5 is default pt size for margins in ggplot.

boxplot_thinlines = geom_boxplot(linewidth = 0.2)

add_leg_box = theme(
    legend.background = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      linetype = "solid"
    )
  )
```

# make the relative abundance half of the figure
```{r}
# make boxplot: 
relab = ggplot(discrete.depth, aes(x = core_bottom_depth_cm, y = 100*ectomycorrhizal, fill = Tree_Health)) + # 'ectomycorrhizal' is a proportion; 100*ectomycorrhizal is a percentage
  boxplot_thinlines +
  labs(x = "Core bottom depth (cm)", y =  "Relative abundance of ectomycorrhizal fungi (%)") +
  theme_minimal() + 
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Tree mortality", values = c("darkblue", "deeppink")) + # colorblind-friendly colors 
  makeMargins +
  fontSizeControl
```

```{r}
# make imputed biomass half of the figure
discrete.depth = mutate(RNA_fungal_trait_biomass, core_bottom_depth_cm = as.character(core_bottom_depth_cm)) # make a dataframe in which depth is a discrete variable
discrete.depth$core_bottom_depth_cm <- factor(discrete.depth$core_bottom_depth_cm, levels=c("7.5", "15", "22.5", "30", "37.5", "45")) # put the levels of depth in order

# make boxplot:
mass = ggplot(discrete.depth, aes(x = core_bottom_depth_cm, y = ectomycorrhizal, fill = Tree_Health)) + # 'ectomycorrhizal' is a proportion; 100*ectomycorrhizal is a percentage
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Core bottom depth (cm)", y = "Imputed biomass of ectomycorrhizal fungi (ng PLFA/g soil)") +
  theme_minimal()  + 
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Tree mortality", values = c("darkblue", "deeppink")) + # colorblind-friendly colors 
  makeMargins +
  fontSizeControl
```

```{r}
# make combined figure with each boxplot as a panel 

supFig5 = ggpubr::ggarrange(
  mass, relab, # list of boxplots
  labels = c("A", "B"), 
  font.label = list(size = 10, color = "black", face = "bold", family = NULL),
  widths = c(5,5),
  common.legend = TRUE, # same legend showing how color maps to tree mortality
  legend = "top", # common legend sits above boxplot panels
  align = "hv", # Align boxplots, horizontally and vertically
  nrow = 1 # boxplots arranged in a single row
)
supFig5
```



```{r}
# create the jpg figure file in this results folder and in the reports folder

jpeg("Results/sup_fig_5_ecm_depth.jpg", width = w_i * ppi, height = h_i * ppi, res = ppi)

supFig5
dev.off()
```

```{r}
# save as pdf
  ggsave(plot = supFig5, filename = ("Results/sup_fig_5_ecm_depth.pdf"), device = "pdf", height = 6, width = 11, units = "in")
  ggsave(plot = supFig5, filename = ("../../Reports/Supplementary Material/Figures/sup_fig_5_ecm_depth.pdf"), device = "pdf", height = 6, width = 11, units = "in")
```
